title: Start Here — Complete User Journey
purpose: Understand the complete content journey and distinguish preview from live work.
prereq: Open the deployed Studio in Chrome. Use a desktop for your first exercise.
steps: Open /studio for live work; /preview stores local demo data and never runs providers.

In AI & budgets, an existing founder explicitly enables Review and preparation. For an administrator-only workspace, follow docs/FOUNDER-SETUP.md; the deployment-designated owner must explicitly claim founder authority first.
Choose per-package/monthly allowances, writing/review connections and verified pricing. Saving credentials or listing a model does not qualify its capabilities or price.

Select an idea to open its linked draft. If automatic first writing is enabled and authorized, copy is prepared within the package allowance. Missing setup stays actionable; older drafts are not auto-generated.
Edit and save the selected draft. Incomplete responses and factual questions remain retained candidates; never pay for an automatic retry of an uncertain result.
Submit for review. In the adopted flow, first approve the exact copy with evidence, then inspect the real textual review and all assets and approve the final package.
Choose date/time in the immediate planner or plan later from Calendar. The exact approved package/platform/account stays selected; no time is invented.
A person publishes outside Studio and separately confirms the live URL. Analytics does not include unconnected social reach or engagement.
Use the training QA workbook for actual acceptance. All manual cases start Not run; local automated checks are not live acceptance.
expected: You can explain each stage and complete one sample post without claiming a real provider call or real publication occurred.
exercise: Create a sample LinkedIn text post about documenting a routine. Complete its checks using honest human evidence. Stop before Confirm published unless you actually published a test item.
troubleshooting: If a control is disabled, check your profile, assignment, channel and active workflow. Do not paste API keys into training files or QA evidence.
availability: Available in preview. Live operation requires the configured /studio workspace. Release 0.3.0: the two-decision flow requires explicit founder adoption; any legacy stage instructions below apply only before adoption. No paid provider or live-account acceptance is implied by these documents.

title: Home and Navigation
purpose: Find work quickly using the dashboard, channel filter, layouts and sidebar.
prereq: Have access to preview or a live workspace.
steps: Open Home. Read the current mode before entering important work.
Choose Command Center or Production Board in the top bar. Command Center shows channel tiles, totals and upcoming work; Production Board groups the same content by progress.
Choose All channels or a channel to narrow the visible records. Changing layout does not create copies of your content.
Use the sidebar icons to open Ideas, Calendar, Create, Reviews, Library, Analytics, Workflow settings, People & access, AI & budgets and Notifications.
Use Collapse sidebar / Expand sidebar to change its width. Use Unpin sidebar for an on-demand drawer; Open menu opens it. Pin sidebar makes it persistent on desktop.
On mobile, Open menu reveals navigation. Close it with the close control or Escape. The drawer should not remain over the selected page.
Open Appearance to choose display settings, then Open selected layout to return Home.
expected: The selected layout and navigation preferences survive a refresh for the same account on that device.
exercise: Switch to Production Board, refresh, switch back, collapse the sidebar, unpin it and reopen it.
troubleshooting: If records seem missing, check the channel filter and search. Browser preferences are local and are not account settings synchronized across devices.
availability: Available in preview. Live operation requires the configured /studio workspace. Release 0.3.0: the two-decision flow requires explicit founder adoption; any legacy stage instructions below apply only before adoption. No paid provider or live-account acceptance is implied by these documents.

title: Account and Appearance
purpose: Inspect your identity and choose an accessible theme, layout and navigation style.
steps: Click the initials avatar at the top right or the user control at the bottom of the sidebar. Both open Account & appearance.
Read Email, Assigned profiles and Workspace mode. In preview, the identity is a sample account; there is no live account to sign out.
Under Home layout, select Command Center or Production Board. Click Open selected layout to see it.
Under Color theme, choose Midnight Teal or Daylight Teal. Check that text, forms, calendar events and focus outlines remain readable.
Under Navigation, set Pin sidebar and Expand sidebar as preferred. Refresh and verify the choices remain.
In a live session, use Sign out on this page. In preview, Open live sign-in takes you to /studio; actual authentication depends on live configuration.
expected: Both avatars open a useful account page; theme and layout choices visibly apply and persist.
exercise: Select Daylight Teal, refresh, return to Midnight Teal, and confirm your email/profile labels.
troubleshooting: Role changes are managed in People & access, not by clicking your own role label. Appearance changes do not grant permissions.
availability: Available in preview. Live operation requires the configured /studio workspace. Release 0.3.0: the two-decision flow requires explicit founder adoption; any legacy stage instructions below apply only before adoption. No paid provider or live-account acceptance is implied by these documents.

title: Ideas — Manual and Agent-Assisted
role: Creator, editor, manager, founder or permitted administrator
purpose: Capture ideas, request candidate ideas and require human selection before drafting.
prereq: Have an active channel workflow. Live generation additionally needs an Ideas provider binding, validated pricing, budgets and a worker.
steps: Choose Tiles or List; summary rows show title, platform, status and created/published dates.
Click an idea to open its complete brief, evidence and details in a popup.
Use idea and open draft approves/selects it within your permissions and opens one linked draft. Reopening the idea does not duplicate it.
With founder-enabled automatic first writing, a new selection can prepare its first copy within the scoped package allowance. Provider/pricing gaps preserve the saved draft and show a reason.
Generate ideas only with configured provider access and verified rates; inspect progress and retained results. Recover existing saved idea results without another AI call where available.
Demo samples are labelled. References do not imply web browsing; actual research/media integrations require separate qualification.
expected: Ideas keep their origin and pending status until a human decides; approved ideas can seed drafts.
exercise: Generate three preview ideas about recovery routines for family caregivers, approve one and create a draft.
troubleshooting: Missing provider connection: configure the Ideas function in AI & budgets and activate the mapping. Research unavailable is an honest limitation, not a successful search. Never cite a source the agent did not actually access.
availability: Available in preview. Live operation requires the configured /studio workspace. Release 0.3.0: the two-decision flow requires explicit founder adoption; any legacy stage instructions below apply only before adoption. No paid provider or live-account acceptance is implied by these documents.

title: Create — Writing, Slides and Scenes
role: Creator or editor assigned to the item; founder/admin as permitted
purpose: Create and maintain the written draft and selected media as separate dependencies.
prereq: Start from an approved idea or Create content. Know your intended channel and format.
steps: Newly selected ideas open one linked draft. Automatic first writing, if enabled and authorized, places complete copy directly in that draft; incomplete/conflicting output stays a reviewable candidate. Explicit Write/Revise with AI remains available within the package allowance.
Open Create and click a content title, or Create content and enter its working title, channel, format and optional publication account.
Edit Content text, title and metadata. Replace placeholders with verified facts; do not invent personal experience or unsupported promises.
Save draft before switching work. Concurrent edits can be rejected rather than silently overwriting another editor; reload and compare versions.

For carousels, use the slide editor for copy and layout. Add text/shape layers, drag or nudge with arrow keys, edit size/color/opacity, reorder, duplicate or remove; save the draft. Layers appear above base copy and their wording is included in factual checks even when transparent. For video, use scenes, scripts, narration, captions and aspect ratio controls. Script-only scenes are not finished rendered video.
Use available generation controls only with a live qualified provider; preview must not be treated as genuine model output. Review every generated result.

Editorial workflow and the right-hand Creative direction start collapsed. Expand when needed; creative direction has a bounded reading area. Use DOCX import/export as needed. A linked Google Doc requires live OAuth configuration; preview fetching intentionally reports unavailable. Optional automatic mode requires founder authority and an initial manual fetch. Conflicts and approved versions hold incoming text for comparison/manual import; displaced branches stay in history.
Use editable source export to retain supported slide/scene data. PNG/PDF are flattened exports; they are not a full design-editor source format.
Complete the visible stage checks and Submit for review. Do not claim Independent review was an agent review unless a real review result supports it.
When changing approved text, keep the old approval snapshot. Recheck affected stages; unchanged media need not be generated again.
expected: The draft saves with a new revision; text edits preserve unchanged visual review while affected factual/release checks reopen.
exercise: Create a text post, save it, export DOCX, change one paragraph and save again. Verify the previous version remains in history.
troubleshooting: Cannot approve video: complete scene media, not just scripts. Cannot save: check stale revision errors and required fields. Uploaded media must be retained Studio assets for live package approval.
availability: Available in preview. Live operation requires the configured /studio workspace. Release 0.3.0: the two-decision flow requires explicit founder adoption; any legacy stage instructions below apply only before adoption. No paid provider or live-account acceptance is implied by these documents.

title: Reviews — Nine Stages and Human Approval
role: Reviewer/manager with grants, founder or authorized approver
purpose: Release the exact reviewed package while preserving evidence and human authority.
prereq: Have a saved draft and active workflow. Only authorized profiles can approve packages.
steps: Reviews uses compact full-width summaries. Open review displays the selected package in a popup.
Before founder adoption, the legacy recorded-stage workflow still applies. After adoption there are two explicit human decisions: copy, then final package.
Read the exact copy, captions, narration and slide wording and check factual claims against supplied references. Record what you actually checked before Approve copy.

Automatic textual review is prepared only if enabled and within the actual package allowance. Missing setup, exhausted funds or uncertain work remain blockers. Same-provider second pass is not independent.
Resolve blocking findings and missing facts. Incomplete or stale responses are not a successful current report; retained output never authorizes a blind paid retry.
Inspect actual text and assets plus the exact platform/account. Explicitly approve the final package; Notes also need founder release authority and required independent review.
An authorized calendar manager receives an immediate date/time planner for that immutable package. Canceling the planner retains the approval and ready-to-plan item.
Publishing remains a person’s external action. Changed released wording requires current copy/final approval again.
expected: Only a human can approve; approval, handoff and publication refer to the exact package and retain their history.
exercise: Try approving before the six checks: it must fail. Complete the checks, approve, edit text and verify the old package is retained.
troubleshooting: Stale workflow/rule/revision: reread current content and repeat affected checks. Founder pricing exceptions are exact-wording/revision scoped; they do not override factual blockers.
availability: Available in preview. Live operation requires the configured /studio workspace. Release 0.3.0: the two-decision flow requires explicit founder adoption; any legacy stage instructions below apply only before adoption. title: Calendar — Drafting, Editing, Workflows and Publication
role: Users permitted to edit the target; authorized publication planners
purpose: Plan work and manual publication, open the correct target, and record completion.
prereq: A draft or workflow must already exist for work tasks. Publication requires an approved package.
steps: After two-step final approval, a permitted calendar manager receives a date/time planner for the exact returned approved package. Time stays blank until chosen. The ready tray and read-only approved snapshot preview remain available if planning is postponed.
Open Calendar. Choose Month or Agenda. Read the displayed Studio timezone; times are entered in that timezone.
Click Add to calendar, choose Drafting, Editing, Workflow work or Approved publication, then Continue. Alternatively use Plan drafting, Plan editing, Plan workflow or Plan publication.
For a work task, enter Task title, select the existing Draft or Workflow, choose a future Task time, add notes and Save planning task. A task never starts an agent or approves content.
Click a date number to begin planning work for that day. If the selected default time is already past, change it to a future time before saving.
Click a work event to open its linked draft or workflow. The task list below the calendar also provides Open draft / Open workflow, Move task, Mark done and Cancel task.
For publication, choose the exact approved package, its publication time and optional campaign group. Save it to the calendar. An unapproved draft is not eligible for publication scheduling.
Click a publication event to open its draft. Use Agenda for publication management: Move, Replace approved package, Block or Confirm published.
Before publishing, verify the correct package has a passed Publication handoff. A human publishes outside Studio.
Only after the post is live, use Confirm published with its HTTPS destination URL. Match the selected approved revision. Studio records the human confirmation; it does not auto-post.
Due planning reminders are created when maintenance runs. Test live reminder delivery only after the worker/maintenance schedule is configured.
expected: Work tasks and publications are visibly distinct; tasks open the correct target and never imply permission to publish.
exercise: Schedule one editing task for tomorrow, open its draft, move it, mark done, then schedule a workflow review. Test publication separately with an approved sample.
troubleshooting: Cannot trash a draft with active tasks: complete/cancel those tasks first. Missing approved packages: complete Reviews first. A blocked publication must be explicitly rescheduled before confirmation.
availability: Available in preview. Live operation requires the configured /studio workspace. Release 0.3.0: the two-decision flow requires explicit founder adoption; any legacy stage instructions below apply only before adoption. No paid provider or live-account acceptance is implied by these documents.

title: Workflow Settings — Instructions, Brand Sources and Guardrails
role: Writer/editor with workflow permission; authorized activator; founder for protected policy
purpose: Maintain channel-specific agent behavior in one reviewed workflow.
prereq: Select the target channel and gather approved brand/reference material.
steps: Choose a highlighted channel tab across the top. Keep workflows collapsed until needed; instruction reading opens separately. Setup is reused for later drafts and does not require reactivation for every post.
Open Workflow settings and choose the channel, including Notes/Newsletter where relevant.

The channel has one current workflow card. Check Created/Updated timestamps, active or pending state, and Text/Ideas bindings. Expand it to read instructions in a popup; earlier revisions are inside collapsed Revision history.
Import a channel preset if needed. The import creates a draft, not an active replacement. Live imports use the uploaded channel material; preview imports sanitized samples.

Create or save a draft version. Add channel instructions, audience constraints, output requirements and applicable brand/reference records. Treat uploaded documents as reference material, not permission to change protected policy.

Use Edit workflow for instructions and Edit connections for model mappings. Choose No connection (remove binding) to clear a mapping. Save changes updates an existing draft in place with an Updated timestamp. Editing active/reviewed instructions creates a pending internal revision in the same card; submit and activate after review. Historical snapshots and credentials remain preserved.
Submit the draft for review. An authorized activator chooses Approve & activate after checking the complete version.
Confirm which version is active before generation. Older versions remain part of the history and approved package snapshots.
Founder-protected rules require founder authority. Administrative infrastructure access alone does not silently become founder approval authority.
expected: One reviewed active version governs each channel; importing/editing does not silently activate instructions.
exercise: Import the LinkedIn preset in preview, edit a draft and submit it. Confirm the previous active version remains until explicit activation.
troubleshooting: No activation button: check role/grants. Existing checks become stale after active workflow/protected-rule changes and must be reconsidered. Do not copy the private brand library into public demo exports.
availability: Available in preview. Live operation requires the configured /studio workspace. Release 0.3.0: the two-decision flow requires explicit founder adoption; any legacy stage instructions below apply only before adoption. No paid provider or live-account acceptance is implied by these documents.

title: Library — References, Templates, History and Trash
role: All users within read scope; editing/approval actions require permissions
purpose: Find retained material and export the right version without confusing working files with release evidence.
prereq: Know whether you need the working draft or an approved package.
steps: Open Library. Use Content for saved items and choose a title to open the working draft.
Use References to maintain brand/context sources. Record channel scope and accurate source text. Untrusted source text cannot override Studio guardrails.
Use Templates for reusable supported slide structures. Templates awaiting approval should not be presented as founder-approved assets.
Use History to inspect who changed what. Restore an older content version as a new draft; it must pass review again and does not inherit old approvals.
For written content, export DOCX or PDF as offered. For slides, export PNG/PDF. Use source JSON for supported editable structure and subtitles for caption timing.
Export an approved package from Reviews when preparing a release. Do not substitute a later edited draft for the approved version.
Use Trash for deleted working content. Recovery is subject to the 90-day policy and dependency protections. Approved release snapshots are retained separately.

Use Export campaign / inventory for a permission-scoped ZIP with exact approved package/assets, dependency manifest and formula-safe CSV. Optional working copies are explicitly unapproved. For MP4, distinguish the implemented local composition tool from pending fully hosted AI scene-generation/render orchestration. A script export is not an MP4.
expected: Exports contain the selected version; restored drafts re-enter review and protected snapshots remain retained.
exercise: Export a draft as DOCX and a slide as PNG, then restore an earlier text version and inspect its new draft status.
troubleshooting: Missing media export: ensure assets exist and are supported/accessible. Flattened PDF/PNG are not editable design layers. Active planning/publication dependencies can prevent Trash actions.
availability: Available in preview. Live operation requires the configured /studio workspace. Release 0.3.0: the two-decision flow requires explicit founder adoption; any legacy stage instructions below apply only before adoption. No paid provider or live-account acceptance is implied by these documents.

title: People and Access — Profiles and Scoped Grants
role: Administrator with membership permission; founder for founder policy
purpose: Assign membership by email while supporting a solo founder or a larger team.
prereq: Live authentication and database must be configured for actual teammate access.
steps: Only an existing Founder may assign/remove/revoke Founder authority. Administrators cannot self-promote. The one-time server-designated first-founder claim is separate from policy/budget adoption; see docs/FOUNDER-SETUP.md.
Open People & access. Review existing members, profiles and any scoped grants.
Choose the add-member control. Enter the teammate email exactly. Assign only the profiles needed: founder, administrator, manager, editor, creator or viewer.
When supported by the live member form, use an initial password to create a sign-in account without an invitation email. Share it through a separate secure channel; never put it in the QA workbook.
One person can have multiple profiles. Explicitly assigning Founder grants founder authority and must be deliberate and auditable.
Use scoped grants only if needed. The current advanced form accepts JSON. Channel/content/account/function restrictions must match within one grant; ask the administrator to validate complex grants.
Test the member in a separate browser profile. Verify assigned drafts, read visibility and allowed actions before granting broader access.
Edit profiles or revoke membership as responsibilities change. Confirm the account loses access after revocation.
In preview, member changes are local demonstrations; they do not invite a real person or create a Supabase account.
expected: Access is enforced by server/database rules and scoped grants, not just hidden UI controls.
exercise: In preview, add a sample viewer profile. For live acceptance, test a real invited viewer in a separate session and verify editing/approval are denied.
troubleshooting: Cannot log in: verify actual account provisioning and membership, not just a preview row. Founder authority and administrator access are distinct. Keep email addresses used in QA limited to test accounts.
availability: Available in preview. Live operation requires the configured /studio workspace. Release 0.3.0: the two-decision flow requires explicit founder adoption; any legacy stage instructions below apply only before adoption. title: AI and Budgets — Providers, Models and Cost Controls
role: Founder and administrators granted AI-settings access
purpose: Configure providers by function and control paid requests and retries.
prereq: Use live credentials only in the secure settings form or server environment; never in documents.
steps: Function setup offers Claude/Anthropic, OpenAI and Gemini/Google, with exact account model discovery or manual API model identifier. Listing is access only, not capability qualification.
Edit an existing connection in place. Leave its key blank to retain encrypted credentials; a changed provider needs a fresh key and model-access check. Active/unknown work protects connection edits.
Load verified pricing, record provider/model/function, USD input/output prices, limits, HTTPS source, date and qualification evidence. Research and media adapters require separate evaluation.

Founder-only Review and preparation explicitly enables two-step policy and optional first writing/automatic textual review. Suggested initial caps are $0.50/package and $5/month, not unlimited spending.
Routine canonical writing/review can reserve within a current scoped allowance. Global, request, connection and total-package caps remain enforced across revisions and retries.
Changed/removed prices block affected queued snapshots before dispatch. Stale forms require reload. Unknown outcomes retain reservations until reconciliation.
Activity keeps active/uncertain work visible, recent ten completed records concise and older history searchable. No queued item is a finished asset.
Keys belong only in Studio/provider setup, never chat, QA evidence or exported training. Demo saves metadata only and cannot qualify paid work.
expected: Paid generation stays blocked until provider, pricing, budget and execution requirements are met.
exercise: Preview an unconfigured generation request and verify it reports the missing setup honestly. Perform paid sample tests only in a separately authorized live test.
troubleshooting: Invalid model: use an ID your provider account actually exposes. No request allowance/rate card: configure and qualify it; do not invent prices or bypass caps. Full video/audio provider qualification remains pending.
availability: Available in preview. Live operation requires the configured /studio workspace. title: Analytics — Content, Publication and Activity
role: All users within their permitted read scope
purpose: Interpret real Studio metrics without confusing records with social engagement.
prereq: Create content and test planning/review flows first to generate meaningful records.
steps: Open Analytics in the sidebar. Check the channel filter; metrics reflect records visible to your profile.
Read current inventory: Content items, In human review, Approved content, Published content, Planned publications and Open planning tasks. These inventory totals are all time.
Choose Activity period: Last 7, 30 or 90 days. Read items updated, approval snapshots and human publication confirmations for that rolling period.
Inspect the daily chart and View daily activity data. Daily grouping is labelled UTC. Approval counts are snapshots, so one content item can produce several approvals.
Read Content by channel. Approved/published content totals count unique content items, not every approval or repost task.
Review Next required checks to see where unpublished work is waiting. Review changes requested and blocked publication tasks.
Inspect AI usage and cost. Recorded actual cost requires reconciliation; reservations are budget holds, not confirmed charges.
Read Social performance. Views, impressions, clicks, followers and engagement are Not connected and must not be reported as zero performance.
expected: Metrics change in line with actual records and filters; no social engagement is fabricated.
exercise: Create an editing task, check Open planning tasks, mark it done and verify the count decreases. Compare approval snapshots with unique approved content.
troubleshooting: Missing teammate records may be correct permission filtering. Published means a human supplied a URL, not independently verified reach. Deleted working content is excluded from current inventory.
availability: Available in preview. Live operation requires the configured /studio workspace. Release 0.3.0: the two-decision flow requires explicit founder adoption; any legacy stage instructions below apply only before adoption. title: Notifications — Inbox and Reminders
role: Each member for their own inbox
purpose: Read workflow reminders and understand delivery prerequisites.
prereq: Have an event that creates a notice. Due reminders require maintenance to run.
steps: Click the bell or Notifications to open your inbox.
Read the event and affected content/task. Open the corresponding section to take the required action.
Use available read/dismiss controls to clear the unread state after reviewing the message.
For due planning work, open Calendar and use Open draft / Open workflow. Complete or move the task as appropriate.
For publication reminders, inspect the exact package and handoff before posting. A reminder never publishes automatically.
Test email only after the transactional email service and dispatch schedule are configured. Password login is independent of notification email.
If no reminder appears, check the task time, timezone, maintenance schedule and your membership before assuming an event failed.
expected: Inbox notices identify events honestly and never substitute for approval or publication.
exercise: Read the sample welcome notice, then test a due task reminder in an authorized maintenance test.
troubleshooting: Preview actions do not send email. Repeated maintenance should not duplicate the same due reminder. A stale reminder can remain in history after the underlying task changes.

title: Operations — Health, Incidents and Recovery
role: Founder or administrator with settings permission
purpose: Inspect recorded failures and dependencies without mistaking a reachable app for a live worker.
prereq: Open a live administrator workspace for real health checks; preview uses local fixtures.
steps: Open Operations using its sidebar button. In preview no external health request is made.

Click Refresh health checks. Inspect database, private asset bucket, encryption configuration, provider execution gate, Google/email configuration and delivery outbox status. These checks report booleans/statuses, never secret values.
Read workspace bytes and the current 24 MB command-store limit. Production-scale archival cutover is still under architecture review; do not delete release evidence to make room.
Review uncertain, expired, failed, blocked or long-queued jobs. A running job whose lease expired requires reconciliation; do not submit another potentially charged request.
Use Open jobs and reconciliation to inspect raw results and record actual outcome/cost using authorized controls. Budget reservations are not actual invoice charges.
Review Google Docs conflicts/errors in the linked draft. Automatic mode is founder-controlled, requires an initial manual fetch and preserves competing Studio and Docs versions.
Worker heartbeat is not tracked. Inspect Render logs to establish whether the worker is currently processing. Successful database checks alone do not prove worker liveness.

For trusted operator backups, follow docs/BACKUP-AND-RECOVERY.md in the repository. The encrypted application backup and local SQL drill do not replace Supabase Auth/project recovery or a live staging restore test.
expected: Operators can identify incidents and next actions without exposing keys or replaying uncertain jobs.
exercise: In preview, inspect a blocked/unknown fixture job. In a credentialed test workspace, refresh checks and compare them with Render logs.
troubleshooting: Only administrators/founders can inspect server health. External email, Google, research pricing/model qualification, platform Auth recovery and final independent review remain separate acceptance items.
availability: Available in preview. Live operation requires the configured /studio workspace.
